title: feat: let each user run 8 sandboxes at once
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Raised the per-user running-sandbox cap from 3 to 8. Creating or resuming a ninth running sandbox returns a 429 telling the user to kill or pause one first; paused sandboxes do not count. The dashboard reads the cap from /alpha/e2b/pricing, so its running count changes without a frontend update. E2B's separate team-wide cap remains 100 running sandboxes, and its start-rate cap remains 5 per second.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, eight little sandbox-shaped flower pots glow lime green (#ecf874) with code-plants growing inside, while paused pots rest on a shelf against a warm cream and pastel gradient background. Polli, the main character, is a small-to-medium cute pixel art bee with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; wearing a tiny tool belt, she tends the pots in cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with dark purple (#110518) outlines.
